headline: KCR @ CHW matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is KCR 4.17 at CHW 4.32, with a projected total of 8.49. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CHW: KCR moved +0.31 runs while CHW moved +0.73, changing the projected margin by -0.42 runs. The projected total climbed +1.03, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +15.1%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Erick Fedde has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 2.4 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Chase Meidroth, Bobby Witt Jr., Vinnie Pasquantino, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Carter Jensen, Luisangel Acuña because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
